release_status: Curated construction, semantic preparation, Shapefile postprocessing and evaluation source. Full historical sensor-to-attributed-map reproduction is not verified.

construction/process_lane_segments.py.changes: Export API accepts explicit coordinate conversion and returns a GeoDataFrame; repair numeric lane IDs; filter zero-length export edges; lazy legacy geographiclib import; fix uninitialized visualization-only state in solid-only windows. Optional arrow callback at window-fit and post-normalization stages preserves the lane return tuple. Fitting thresholds unchanged. See SOURCE_GUIDE.md.

construction/save_stopline_points.py.changes: Accept an argv list; require explicit input, pose and output paths; visualization defaults off. Segmentation rules unchanged.

construction/road_structure_analyzer.py.changes: Unmodified supporting research module; not automatically invoked by generate_map.py.

construction/generate_map.py.changes: New headless orchestration, input/output validation, explicit CRS conversion, logging and failure reporting. Optional recovered arrow module; closed-LineString box export with separate cluster-mean fields and per-class counts. Not a new reconstruction algorithm.

construction/arrow_generation.py.scope: Arrow functions only; does not replace the canonical lane fitter.
construction/arrow_generation.py.changes: Extract active arrow clustering, lane filtering and rectangle construction. Remove GUI/debug drawing; add input and empty-result guards. Normalize nested lane arrays, including two-point lists and deep nesting previously skipped or rejected; not universally output-equivalent. Preserve numeric thresholds and separate box-midpoint/cluster-mean conventions. See SOURCE_GUIDE.md for retained limitations.

construction/semantic/myConcateTemp.py.changes: Explicit data/model/calibration/mask arguments, lazy runtime dependencies, direct pypcd4 API and output validation; original projection and fusion calculations retained.

construction/semantic/arrow_postprocess..changes: Explicit car-mask argument and use-site imports; original mask-recovery calculations retained.

construction/semantic/predict.py.changes: Isolate optional inference dependencies and explicit model paths; retain colormaps and legacy factory conventions.

construction/semantic/arrow_vectorized.p.changes: Explicit input CLI and lazy GUI dependencies; remains an inspection tool, not a Shapefile exporter.

construction/semantic/configs/segformer_.changes: Retain model architecture, preprocessing, test pipeline and visualizer. Disable backbone pretraining initialization because full weights are required. Omit training datasets, optimizer and private paths. Add the test_dataloader.dataset.pipeline view required by MMSegInferencer. No weights are bundled.

postprocessing/fusion_multishp.py.changes: Parameterized merge/arrows entry points, CRS validation, preserve actual CRS instead of hardcoded assignment, output guards and import safety. Preserve schema and ID-normalization conventions.

postprocessing/cal_shp_lane_info.py.changes: Wrap attribute processing in explicit CLI, validate legacy schema and supported CRS, isolate optional imports and protect outputs. Handle vertical first segments with infinite slope and horizontal normal; other width/count rules retained.

postprocessing/prepare_lane_attributes.p.changes: New schema-only adapter for lane construction output and the legacy width calculation. Requires explicit angle gate, preserves original IDs/metadata, creates unique feature scan IDs and keeps unknown graph nodes null. No geometry or topology inference.

postprocessing/cal_shp_lane_info_lanenum.changes: Explicit CLI and validation; retain original lane-number/label calculations and positional field assumptions; remove import-time environment mutation.

postprocessing/convert_3d_to_2d.py.changes: Descriptive filename, explicit input/output CLI, lazy GDAL import and overwrite protection; preserve XY and endpoint-Z extraction.

excluded_sources: removable-drive lane fitter and dataset-specific main (only confirmed arrow functions imported)
license_status: Upstream HDMap MIT notice retained; author-added source has no newly assigned repository-wide license. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
